tasks.gr7-listening-speaking-t2: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 7 Term 2). Cover shopping, transport, service encounters, giving directions, and polite requests. Ask learners to select courteous request forms, respond to short role-play exchanges, interpret map-direction language, and sequence oral instructions in familiar community contexts.
tasks.gr7-reading-viewing-t2: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 7 Term 2). Cover news snippets, folk stories, simple informational texts, timetables, and signs. Ask learners to identify main ideas and key details, compare factual and fictional content, match timetable or sign information to questions, and choose evidence-based comprehension answers.
tasks.gr7-writing-presenting-t2: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 7 Term 2). Cover diary entries, short reports, dialogues, instructions, and messages. Ask learners to choose suitable formats, organise writing in logical sequence, apply audience and purpose, and edit short texts for clarity, spelling, and punctuation.
tasks.gr7-language-structures-t2: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 7 Term 2). Cover negatives, question forms, pronouns, subject concords, and adjectives. Ask learners to convert statements to questions or negatives, choose pronouns and concords that agree with subjects, and complete sentence gaps with accurate adjective forms.
